scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The proposed KCNK9/KCNK2-to-resting-K+ conductance-to-input-resistance mechanism is biologically coherent and experimentally defensible. However, K2P dominance and the asserted Pvalb-versus-Vip expression pattern are somewhat overstated, and reduced excitability after leak-channel knockdown is not the generally expected consequence of increased input resistance.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: KCNK9 and KCNK2 expression are explicitly connected through resting K+ conductance to input resistance, with Pvalb and Vip identities used to define contrasting cellular contexts. The two channels are not mechanistically distinguished, and cell size and other conductances remain controls or caveats rather than integrated parts of the explanation. No synthesis ceiling was applied because the focus-feature–target mechanism and its principal intermediate are explicit.
